scholarships.name: Americas Bursary
scholarships.programs: Applicable Programs: Bachelor of Commerce Eligibility: This grant is open to international applicants who are citizens of one of the following countries:
scholarships.validity_text: Award End Date: This grant is valid until the end of 2025, with Fall 2025 being the last intake available for eligibility. Eligible applicants will need to submit their applications by the admission deadlines.
conditions: The student must commence their program before their offer for admission expires.
The student must keep programs.
The student must pay all fees (that are not covered by the award) by their respective due dates.
The student must maintain good academic standing.
The student must maintain a full-time enrolment status.
notes: The source labels this a bursary, but the published benefit lines are International Scholarship and Regional Scholarship; it is granted at admission.
